source_text: Post haec firmamentum meretur luminaribus adornari. Et dixit Deus: Fiant luminaria in firmamento caeli, ut luceant super terram, et dividant inter diem et noctem. Sol et luna et stellae in firmamento — in ecclesia et in homine caelesti — posita sunt, ut qui in corpore sunt illuminatione Verbi et legis et prophetarum regantur.
pass_a_gloss: After these firmament deserves with-lights to-be-adorned. And said God: Let-be lights in firmament of-heaven, that they-may-shine over earth, and may-divide between day and night. Sun and moon and stars in firmament — in church and in human heavenly — placed are, that who in body are by-illumination of-Word and of-law and of-prophets may-be-ruled.
pass_b_english: After this the firmament deserves to be adorned with lights. [[God said: Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven, to shine upon the earth and to divide day from night >> Bible:Genesis 1:14-15]]. Sun and moon and stars are set in the firmament — in the church and in the heavenly human — so that those still in the body may be ruled by the illumination of the Word and of the law and the prophets.
